insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: Yone is always on their mind
insights.text: They pick or ban Yone in 28/54 games (52%): 0 picks (0-0) and 28 bans.

insights.question: What pick/ban tendencies repeat most?
insights.title: They open bans on Yone
insights.text: Yone is their first ban in 19/54 games (35%). Expect it gone before your first pick.

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: They fade once their pool is burned

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: No Jhin? They go Ashe
insights.text: Jhin is a G1 favorite (7/23 G1s, played by Ayu). In the 19 later games where it was burned or banned, Ayu went to Ashe (3/19) and Senna (3/19).

insights.question: How does the draft shift in Fearless G2/G3+?
insights.title: In G3+ they go about as deep as the league
insights.text: In 15 G3+ games, 22/75 picks (29%) were champions they never played in any G1 (league 31%). Pool: 51 champs in G1s, 47 in G3+.
